programmes.d: Experience Goodwood Festival of Speed as legendary cars and drivers tear up the hill in nonstop celebration!
Follow the Aston Martin Valkyrie from Silverstone to Le Mans in a road trip showcasing power and design!
Join a thrilling Mille Miglia journey in a Bugatti Veyron Vitesse over 1,000 exhilarating miles!
Explore the groundbreaking RS2 and B5 RS4. Then, Audi Sport transforms rally prowess into road legends!
Dive into Audi Sport's journey in rallying, Quattro revolution and its iconic performance cars.
Race in the F56 Mini Challenge at Brands Hatch. Then, compare the BMW M4 with the M5.
In this track battle, Jaguar F-Type takes on the Porsche 911 while the Morgan Plus 8 takes on the BMW R9T.
The Porsche 959 redefines its 80s performance. Then, test the fun of the Toyota GT86 and Mazda MX-5!
Review the McLaren 675LT and Proteus C-Type. Then, compare the Renaultsport Megane against Honda Civic Type R.
Watch the showdown between the Porsche GT3 RS, McLaren 750S and Radical SR3 XXR.
evo's Editorial Director, Harry Metcalfe, drives the 2012 Mille Miglia in a 1955 Alfa 1900 SS across Italy.
Join the Mk2 Escort at the Woodpecker Rally then a track battle between the McLaren P1 and Porsche 918 Spyder.
The Hyundai i30 N takes on Honda Civic Type R in this track showdown.
In this track showdown, GT2 RS wins over SLS and F-Type wins over Street Triple.
Travel to Nice in the SLS Roadster. Then, review a turbo car lineup and Ferrari's 2016 Paris Motor Show.
Porsche, Rimac and Maserati thrill with innovation. Then, review the 919 Hybrid at the Geneva Motor Show.
The Ferrari 488 Pista excels at Anglesey. Then, review the features of the Bugatti Chiron.
Watch the McLaren 750S take on the Ferrari 296 GTB. Then, enjoy a review of Ariel Atom 3.5R.
Danny and Horny Mike get too close for comfort when they convince a Model-T Hot Rod owner to let them take it for a spin. Later, a Soap Box race car brings out the inner child in Roli and Mike.
Danny's friend Brian has always wanted to ride a motorcycle but has never been able due to his physical limitations. Will Danny and the guys be able to get Brian in the wind for the first time?

Danny gets sidetracked by a curious lady in a hot pink Beetle while trying to score a classic Ford Galaxie. Later, a Hollywood icon confronts Horny Mike and Roli in the shop parking lot. Will Danny be able to diffuse the situation before it explodes?

Danny is commissioned by Barry White's estate to find and restore the legendary singer's Stutz IV Porte. Meanwhile, an old pullover visits the shop with a custom job that could teach The Count a lesson.

Horny Mike discovers a coveted bike frame on private property and convinces Danny to risk it all by sneaking inside. Later, Scott is miffed by a last-minute creative change that is guaranteed to cost the shop big money.

Danny takes on his most emotional project yet after spotting a 70 Dodge Challenger on a private road. Later, Kevin s lunch is interrupted by a rare 63 Corvette, while Horny Mike and Roli get lost cruising in a clunker.
Kevin and Horny Mike make an unauthorized purchase, forcing Danny to teach them a valuable lesson. Later, Danny runs into trouble himself after acquiring a Chevelle the shop doesn't have room for.

Danny and Shannon honor fallen troops with a custom patriotic motorcycle. Later, Danny and Kevin push the limit to acquire a `71 Monte Carlo, and then have a tough decision to make when a heart-broken customer can't pay up.
Danny and Kevin find themselves in hot water when a motorcycle pullover goes south. Later, a woman brings in her recovered IROC-Z and leaves with a genius thief-busting solution.
Danny is visited by legendary Mistress of the Dark, Elvira, whose famous Thunderbird is in need of some mechanical magic.
Danny may be in over his head when he takes on his first boat. Will he be able to tread through the rough waters or will he be forced to abandon ship?
Tasked with building a custom bike for a disabled man, Danny and his team must figure out a way to tackle a tricky transformation.

Scott’s 1953 Fleetwood is a monumental challenge that takes a turn to the crazy when Dan has to add rare features that the car never had in the first place. John wants FantomWorks to make his 1967 Mercury Cougar roaring more fiercely than ever.

Rick comes to FantomWorks for a nightmare combination of gadgets, gizmos, and upgrades for his 1972 Cadillac Hearse. Merlyn and Lynn are farmers from Minnesota with a 1959 Chevy Apache that’s so dangerous they’ve never driven it beyond their driveway.

Mickey’s 1970 Chevelle is perfect, but he wants FantomWorks to tear it apart and upgrade everything to make it his own. Thom’s 1963 Studebaker is a project car with a nightmare combination of leaks, bad parts and a rusted-out floor held together by glue.

At FantomWorks, there are 85 cars being worked on and multiple owners who expect miracles. From a vintage motorcycle to getting a 1970 GTO ready for a returning vet, Dan burns the midnight oil to get cars out the door so new arrivals can take their place.

When Donnie decides that he wants to take his 1968 Fastback to SEMA, Dan and FantomWorks are thrown for a loop. Now, they need to get the Fastback and a 1964 Corvette to the prestigious show within a crushing time frame.

When George brings his beloved 1971 Mustang Mach 1 in for a few repairs, Dan realizes that his car has been jumped. Mick hired a shop to restore his 1952 Mercury Woody. The shop went bust, so FantomWorks is challenged to pick up the pieces. Literally.

Ian wants a 1956 ‘baby bird’ restomod that drives like a sports car. Dan’s solution – a GTO-Thunderbird combo that drives like a bat out of hell. Doc Pellerin’s 1937 Volvo was a regular winner at Concours car shows – until a shelf fell on the car…

Jerry shows up with a car in pieces, a U-Haul full of parts and a dream of a perfect Plymouth Business Coupe that desperately needs Dan’s help. Bill asks Dan to find him a 1972 Gran Sport and to restore it with hard-to-find features.
The R8 V10 Plus beats the 911 Turbo S in wet conditions. Then, Audi TT Cup challenges.
evo reviews the Fiesta R5 rally, the GranTurismo and the Bentley EXP 10's luxury at Geneva 2015.
Drive the McLaren P1 GTR 986-hp in a track joyride. Then, a Mini Cooper race in a thrilling 3-lap duel.
The Porsche 911 4S tops 2S in the rain. Then, the Mini JCW GP take on the Audi A1 and Focus RS500 on track.
Car reviews: McLaren 570S Spider, Eagle Low Drag GT, Porsche Cayman GTS and Alfa Giulia Quadrifoglio.
Witness a Porsche 911 GT3 speed test then a V12 showdown!
Compare the Audi RS 3, Toyota GR Yaris and AMG A45 S in a four-wheel hatch showdown!
